text: ひんしに　なったら　どうなるの？

structure.jp: ひんしに　なったら

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.span: ひんしに　なったら
patterns.explanation: に plus なる means to become that thing or end up in that state. ひんしに なる = 'to become fainted'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'when' that happens. ひんしに なったら = 'if they faint'.

patterns.name: 〜の (question)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a casual sentence makes it a soft question asking for an explanation. どう なるの？ = 'what happens?'.
